exact_line: My bank-shot insurance finally paid out!
I'd like to file a claim. Cause of damage: your excellent aim.
Victory first. Snacks immediately after.
You win the frame. I'm still winning the snack queue.
That's not chalk dust. That's the sparkle of success.
Turns out confidence needs a little more practice.
I calculated that! Well... most of it.
My experimental safety has produced a very unexpected champion.
Lucky eight. I knew you hadn't forgotten me.
My lucky number would like to speak to your lucky number.
Trouble and I have become very close friends.
I've renamed that pocket: Your Fault. Nicely played!
An excellent improvisation, if I say so myself.
My mistake had great spin. Your finish had better timing.
My doubles partner agrees: that was brilliant.
We've held a team meeting. Both of me demand a rematch.
Left hand, right result. Beautiful.
I'll blame my other hand. This one knows you played well.
Cue the music. The victory dance is officially on.
You stole my frame and interrupted my choreography!
Spontaneous genius. Please spell it right on the trophy.
My luck stepped outside. Your skill stayed at the table.
The pockets have approved my management style.
Looks like the club has a new manager. Good frame.
A polished plan deserves a polished finish.
You put a dent in my composure. Very stylishly done.
The perfect angle. The perfectly predictable result.
You found the one corner I hadn't accounted for.
Did you blink? No? Good, I want witnesses.
You stopped Mercury in its tracks. That's a quick lesson.
Still unbothered. Just slightly more victorious.
A small crack in the ice. You earned that one.
The white ball arrived exactly on schedule.
My itinerary has been cancelled. Your route was better.
Distance makes the victory look even sweeter.
Long shot, short explanation: you played beautifully.
That advice will be available after the rematch.
I appear to have talked myself out of a victory.
The calculations were correct. I do enjoy that feeling.
One variable escaped me. It was you.
A gentle touch. A rather firm result.
Your finish was lovely. My ego will need a softer cushion.
A perfect connection. Right through to the next round.
You changed the route. I rather admire the engineering.
The rack survived. Your chances were less fortunate.
I brought the thunder. You brought the finishing touch.
Professional courtesy: I made the lesson look elegant.
Mind the step? You've just walked straight past me.
A convincing experiment. The result supports my theory.
Excellent evidence. I shall be revising my entire hypothesis.
A silk-smooth finish. No wrinkles anywhere.
You found the loose thread. Beautifully played.
A little spin, a little art, a very nice score.
My masterpiece has been politely corrected by your cue.
The opening was an illusion. The victory is quite real.
You saw through the trick. I didn't see that finish coming.
Another route added to the atlas.
A new route! After all these years, you still surprised me.
The audience got its best shot after all.
That deserved applause. Allow me to start.
The final piece fits. Shall I explain the solution?
Your solution was annoyingly elegant. I approve.
Low lights. High standards. Clean finish.
You kept your nerve when the lights got low. Respect.
Energy conserved. Victory secured.
You redirected all that energy straight into a win.
A little pressure. A very warm comeback.
You put out the comeback before it caught fire. Well played.
The castle stands. The gate remains closed.
You found the gate. I may have to build another wall.
A masterclass, with a complimentary final flourish.
Consider that your graduation. The next club is waiting.
A brilliant finale. Naturally, I had a part in it.
You stole the spotlight. I suppose I can applaud from here.
One promise kept. One beautifully closed frame.
I promised a difficult finish. You made yours look easy.
That angle has served me well for many years.
A new angle at my age. What an excellent surprise.
A little radiance, a very bright result.
The spotlight is yours tonight. Enjoy every second.
My reservation was honoured. Excellent service.
My reservation was cancelled. Apparently, you booked the whole table.
A quick finish. Plenty of time to enjoy it.
You caught the blitz. I wasn't expecting a traffic stop.
The scoreboard has solved the mystery.
You've seen through the ghost. I may have to learn a new haunting.
A calm cue. A perfectly timed finish.
You changed the rhythm and kept your balance. Exquisite.
Pressure creates diamonds. Mine appear to be sparkling.
That's a finish made under pressure. Keep the diamond.
Darling, the fans do appreciate a proper finale.
The fans want your autograph now. I can't even blame them.
Thunder rolls. Another frame follows.
You weathered the storm. That was a champion's finish.
The final lesson? There is always another angle.
Forty-eight rivals. One champion. You've earned that name.
